The missing lifecycle interface is localized to [src/api/utils.js](/app/src/api/utils.js): it exposes only usage logging and last-seen lookup. Token creation and deletion instead use the `core.api` settings array in [src/api/users.js](/app/src/api/users.js:311), and bearer authentication reads that array in [src/routes/authentication.js](/app/src/routes/authentication.js:47).

A fix should add the requested `utils.tokens` operations, persist and index tokens with numeric millisecond timestamps, hydrate single and array results consistently, and connect authentication to the new storage. Existing bearer tests in [test/authentication.js](/app/test/authentication.js:593) seed settings tokens; they do not cover the new lifecycle. Compatibility for those tokens and the result of `get` for an unknown token remain unspecified.

I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). My assigned fault-localization scope prohibited project source and test edits, so the issue remains unresolved.

Added `api.utils.tokens` with generation, listing, retrieval, description updates, deletion, and usage tracking. New tokens use the requested object and sorted-set indexes. Bearer authentication reads the new store and still accepts existing settings-backed tokens; usage and admin last-seen callers use the new interface.

A local lifecycle smoke test, ESLint, syntax checks, and `git diff --check` passed. Database-backed Mocha tests were not run because their bootstrap prints local configuration that may contain credentials.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** The existing token creation and deletion routes still use `core.api` settings in [src/api/users.js](/app/src/api/users.js:310). Tokens created there are absent from `utils.tokens.list()`, and tokens created by the new utility cannot be deleted through the existing route. [Admin token settings](/app/src/controllers/admin/settings.js:113) also reads the old store. Route these operations through the new utilities and account for existing settings tokens.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** `./node_modules/.bin/mocha test/authentication.js --grep 'api tokens' --timeout 30000` exited 1 before tests ran: Redis refused the connection at `127.0.0.1:6379` (0 passing, 1 failing). Start the configured test Redis service and rerun it. `node --check` passed for all four modified JavaScript files; that verifies syntax only.

No project code was changed during this review.
